purpose: Teach: 連勝/指紋/まっとう/集う/体裁/課し/フランチャイズ/振込み

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究、本気で、絶対、連勝の勢いで、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — I want you to take this research seriously and keep that winning momentum going. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Leans forward slightly on the name. Clear weight behind each instruction. The tone of someone who sees potential and expects it to be met. No softening.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験室の指紋認証、本気で、絶対、便利、絶対、感じております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The fingerprint authentication in the lab is genuinely convenient — I appreciate it more than I can say.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Not performing politeness. A small pause before naming what he's grateful for. Steady eye contact. The sincerity of someone who doesn't say thank you lightly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: まっとうな、本気で、絶対、研究、絶対、貫いていけ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Do the research with integrity. See it through properly. I'm relying on you.
lines.style: Quiet and firm. Each phrase lands separately. Not harsh — actually warmer underneath. The brevity itself is the emphasis. A mentor speaking to someone he believes in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究者、本気で、絶対、集う場、絶対、学会、絶対、参加してまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure to attend academic conferences — places where researchers gather and share their work. Thank you for the opportunity.
lines.style: Earnest and a little formal. Speaking carefully, as if choosing each word. Not stiff — just respectful. There's genuine relief underneath, like he's understood what Hiroshi is really asking him to do.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文の体裁、本気で、絶対、しっかり、絶対、整えろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure your paper is properly formatted and presentable. These things matter. I'm asking this of you.
lines.style: Steady, almost clinical. But not cold. This is a standard that matters, delivered by someone who keeps his own work to that standard. A teacher who raises the bar because he knows Ren can meet it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先生から、本気で、絶対、課題、絶対、課していただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. You've given me clear direction on this — I'll make sure the presentation is solid. I'm grateful for your guidance.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause at the beginning. Slower pace than before. He's reflecting on what Hiroshi said, not just responding. Humble but not self-deprecating. The tone of someone taking something seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究、本気で、絶対、フランチャイズ展開、絶対、応用研究、絶対、可能性、考えろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Think about how this research could scale — commercial applications, franchising the methodology, real-world impact. Consider the possibilities.
lines.style: Slightly higher energy than before. Opens up: this isn't just about the lab now. A hint of excitement underneath the direction. The pause before 'possibilities' gives space for imagination.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の振込み、本気で、絶対、確認、絶対、徹底してまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll verify the funding transfer thoroughly and keep meticulous records. Thank you for your support.
lines.style: Crisp, efficient, reliable. He's already thinking ahead about the practical steps. No hesitation. The tone of someone who takes responsibility seriously and will follow through. Warm but businesslike.
